needsBespoke.why: Cursed Touch is a global damage-amplifying rider that applies to every subsequent instance of incoming magic damage against a marked target (from any of Amumu's own magic sources: Q, W ticks, E, R), not a normal on-hit or single-ability rider. It has explicit ordering rules the closed primitives don't express: an autoattack's own on-hit magic damage is NOT amplified by the mark that same attack just applied; R's own damage is amplified only if the target was already marked before R hit (R's own mark-refresh happens after R's damage); and R's mark application is negated entirely if blocked by a spell shield. Correctly simulating total damage requires custom sequencing logic (mark timestamp vs. each damage instance's resolution order) beyond what target-debuff/conditional-damage alone can encode.
